title: Prove common24 P112 direction bound and exclude two literal C5 callers
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Prove that for ONE common set S of at most **24 live P112 coordinates**, at most **two projective directions** over any characteristic-zero field have residual binary support rank at most seven. A literal independent pair at cut24 attains two; sharpness of the cut allowance is unclaimed.

This excludes two different actual historical TWOSIDE (b,t)=(5,6) independent-piece callers at code-intersection dimension at least five:

- **2^4,3,5,7^5**: six-piece quotient basis support cap 8+4+12=24.
- **2^4,4^2,7^5**: six-piece quotient basis support cap 8+8+8=24.

Because24<53, those six images form a quotient basis of dimension six. The five remaining rank-seven pieces give five independent code directions under the SAME cut, contradicting the new limit two. All 462 six-piece capacity-sum tests are checked per caller;24 is a minimum certified capacity sum, not a lower bound on actual support unions. No full cell, full C5, decoder floor, supplier, multiplication theorem or new kappa follows.

[PROOF.md](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7e8d98e351ac153d81943218bf168dc8548b1cea/research/p112-common24-caller/PROOF.md) supplies the chamber/rational-kernel reduction, complete common-cut split and exact quotient transfer. Signed reflection closure and finite-group maximization replace a chamber black box. No embedding of the coefficient field into R or C, or frame preservation under Weyl moves, is assumed.

## Task, overlap and source credit

Explicit user follow-up to [PR #3951](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3951); changed complex-rank-shape-decoder scope, priority revision 6. [PR #3951](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3951)'s exact 9aacf01 [upstream CI](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39210345012) passes. At entry and the 06:58:54UTC checkpoint it had no comments, submitted reviews or inline threads.

Canonical main was fetched unchanged at entry, the caller pivot and publication checkpoint:20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90. Entry/final overlap covered 657/662 open PR bodies, including drafts, over seven nonempty pages plus empty eighth; the helper searched2,492 local records. Rendered C5/handoff/start-here text was checked. Discussion-wide, arbitrary closed/diff/private-work coverage remains partial; no novelty certificate.

The adjacent ten-piece2^3,3,5,7^5 caller already follows from [PR #3931](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3931)'s common23 theorem via a quotient basis of support22. That is credited reuse. The new two callers require the next capacity sum24; no general two-flat rank-seven census is launched.

Credit Nick Petalas/[PR #3269](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3269) (global capacities), [PR #3163](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3163) (shared-cut/full-direction predecessor), [PR #3282](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3282)/[PR #3289](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3289) (retained filter and caller composition), DreamingOfClouds/[PR #3154](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3154) (TWOSIDE/C5), David Arias (quadratic model), joaqcoo and E8/P112 lineage. Exact heads and roles are in PREDECESSORS.json. This donor's [PR #3931](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3931) head33b6be488be1e9e38f2f3f9bcfc4a7db0e8a332d and [PR #3951](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3951) head9aacf01037f6e19cabb95ccbea15fcc2965dcd4d are preceding theorem/audit context. model.py is explicitly adapted from [PR #3951](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3951); it is not claimed independently implemented relative to that model. Runtime needs no pending Git object. Frozen predecessors and selected records are unchanged.

## Validation

Published commit **7e8d98e351ac153d81943218bf168dc8548b1cea**, treef4cd46e1847485a4c46610f8de73a8dc8a94fe68:12 added files only in research/p112-common24-caller. CPython 3.12.3/Linux, standard library only:

    python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-common24-caller

All three registered optimized commands pass. The primary covers 43,435 seven-spaces,5,212,200 normal/space pairs,6,216 critical records,6,188 cuts and 8,540 complete candidate sets, including frame normals. It rechecks all 3,309,747 five-spaces for the caller's inherited capacity 12. A separate no-primary/predecessor-import checker uses Cramer/Bareiss labels,43,180 affine sections plus 255 leading-zero spaces, subset joins and different admission lookups. Full flat/record/admission digests agree.

Controls cover all 67 subspaces of a four-space, all 12,166 original (5,6) filter multisets (77 survivors), the literal independent pair, five independent directions with separate21-cuts whose243 possible common unions have minimum 44, characteristic-two loss, label/JSON rejections and three actual optimized CLI corruptions including a Boolean-for-integer-one receipt. Metadata/source pins, syntax/JSON/whitespace and exact 16-file committed-byte/source-history preflight pass. No lint pass is claimed.

The corrected exact commit passes the official committed export integrity check and all three actual commands under -I -O -Werror -B from a read-only source export with Git absent from PATH. All 17 hashes remain unchanged. Single runs measured 22.834s primary,13.745s separate checker and 26.564s controls; these are not benchmarks.

The first read-only export caught copytree preserving read-only modes in the owned corruption-test copies. Follow-up7e8d98e restores owner-write permission only on those private copies. Scientific commitfd3c969, primary/independent code, proof, sources and numerical receipt are unchanged. [Hosted CI39213897983](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39213897983) **passed on exact head7e8d98e351ac153d81943218bf168dc8548b1cea at 2026-10-19 07:10:32UTC**. Both planning and replay jobs succeeded; logs contain the theorem, separate-checker, control and registered-package PASS markers, and the committed-inputs-unchanged step passed. These are written mathematics and computational checks in the same donor/assistant context, not independent human or formal-kernel acceptance. Selected cold replay, Lean, Docker and physical/native/restoration/consumer/all-size/supplier admission are unrun or unestablished.

## Open next questions

Review the generic-normal rank argument,21-cut perfect-matching reduction and complete common-cut candidate split. Before another census, reconcile a different actual caller;2^5,6,7^5 has a preferred quotient cap 30 and needs five directions, beyond this24 contract. Its current public status and extra coefficient constraints are not settled here. This session stops after the two named exclusions; no continuing reservation.
